summary: Gamekeeper who built the Jägerhäusle in 1801 and served as Vogt, or headman, of Unteribental; probably John's 6th great-uncle.
bio: Andreas Heitzler (1764–1836) was a gamekeeper, or Jäger, at Unteribental. In 1801 he built the Jägerhäusle, the hunter's cottage, on manorial land, and by 1813 he was serving as Vogt, the village headman, of Unteribental. He was probably John's 6th great-uncle.
